tools.name: web
preconditions: Use primary/official sources for technical claims

tools.name: exec
preconditions: Respect task mutation_policy

tools.name: context-pack
preconditions: Write reports only inside project root
--postflight executes declared argv; never expose it over MCP

tools.name: gate-receipt
preconditions: Bind every input/tool/config by SHA-256

tools.name: research-promotion-gate
preconditions: Never edit SKILL, board, or schematic files
Treat domain allowlist and URL liveness only as screening signals
Require human KABUL before promotion

tools.name: crosstalk-thinning
preconditions: Screening only: model_class=exploratory_closed_form, signoff=false
Never emit SAFE_TO_THIN without dielectric_height_mm, coupled_length_mm and rise_time_ps
Never thin an impedance-controlled net
FEXT is not modelled; microstrip results carry a CONFIRM
Writes no board or schematic file

tools.name: zdiff-solver
preconditions: Screening only: model_class=exploratory_closed_form, signoff=false
Closed-form error is systematic (-29.94%..+2.41% in the published Polar comparison)
Controlled impedance requires a 2D field solver against the real fab stackup
That solver now exists: prefer field-solver, which reports both answers and their delta
Target impedance is a required positional argument

tools.name: field-solver
preconditions: model_class=numerical_2d_fdm, signoff=false: nominal er, lossless, no roughness, no measured coupon
Validated against the exact analytic coax; rectangles land on the grid, circles staircase
Grid error is bounded only with --refine
Reports the IPC-2141 answer alongside its own, so the closed-form bias is measured
Geometry is a required positional argument

tools.name: monte-carlo
preconditions: signoff=false; yields carry a Wilson 95% interval and the seed
Draws are INDEPENDENT; a tolerance needs an explicit sigma_divisor
DC bias with no vendor derating curve is NO_COVERAGE
circuit is .op only; absent ngspice is NO_COVERAGE
impedance linearises the field solve and refuses a bad linear fit
Subject is a required positional argument

tools.name: electrothermal
preconditions: Closes the R(T) loop current_density and thermal_bridge never closed
Loop gain G = I^2*R20*alpha*Rth; G >= 1 means NO steady state and the tool names no temperature
The refusal comes from the closed-form gain, not from the iteration failing to settle
--thermal-resistance-k-per-w is REQUIRED; the loop gain is proportional to it
DC only, one lumped temperature; a real trace has a gradient and a hotter peak
Reports the uncoupled answer alongside, so the size of the old error is visible
A stable gain says a steady state EXISTS, not that its temperature is acceptable

tools.name: coupon-plan
preconditions: Runs BEFORE gerber output: miss the coupon and the board returns unmeasurable
--tdr-rise-time-ps is REQUIRED and never defaulted; it sets the resolution and therefore the length
A coupon shorter than the TDR can resolve reads a transition, not an impedance, and does not fail loudly
er_eff is solved (--solve) or stated (--er-eff), never guessed; the report says which
Plans the coupon; does NOT lay it out, place it on the panel or emit gerber
A coupon shares the stackup, not the routing: it validates the cross-section, not the production net

tools.name: loop-stability
preconditions: Models NOTHING; it reads a response an AC simulation or a network analyser produced
Runs without a vendor's compensation note: locating a 0 dB crossing is not proprietary, the thresholds are
Finds EVERY 0 dB crossing; a loop is only as good as its worst one
Detects conditional stability: phase past -180 deg while gain is still up, which a crossover margin cannot see
Unwraps phase and REPORTS the wrap count; a margin from wrapped phase is plausibly wrong, not obviously wrong
No crossing in band is NO_COVERAGE, never a pass and never extrapolated
Acceptance thresholds are inputs; without them the margins are computed but unjudged
Each crossing carries its bracketing samples: a crossover from decade-spaced data is not known to four digits
A headerless CSV is refused - magnitude and phase are both plain numbers and swapping them parses cleanly

tools.name: rail-budget
preconditions: Checks what ERC cannot: a netlist proves EN is CONNECTED, never that the rail on it can turn the regulator on
V_EN(HI) is a datasheet input, never defaulted; an undeclared threshold is NO_COVERAGE
A thin POSITIVE margin is a separate finding from a negative one - it passes at 25 C and fails at the corner
Compares the WRITTEN power-up order against the enable graph; only an inversion is a contradiction
An enable cycle is refused; a topological sort that drops it reports a shorter, plausible order
Rails in one enable tier are not ordered against each other - the graph does not order them
Deterministic noise adds linearly, random adds in quadrature; summing deterministic in quadrature understates it
PSRR is a curve: a figure quoted at another frequency is REFUSED, not interpolated
An absent noise budget still produces the sum, but nothing calls it acceptable

tools.name: block-catalog
preconditions: The side that READS an architecture decision; an unread decision drifts from the design in silence
Emission and verification come from ONE record, so two documents cannot fall out of sync by hand
The catalogue is a data TABLE, not an if-chain: a caller cannot pick the connector and forget its impedance rule
No parameter is defaulted; a missing required parameter is a refusal that names itself
Emits component ROLES with constraints, never MPNs - sourcing has inputs not visible at this phase
Emits no schematic: generated schematics erase edits made behind the generator
Verification is three-valued; 'unverifiable' never folds into 'present', and no netlist is NO_COVERAGE
A net that EXISTS with a generated name is ABSENT for rule-binding purposes - and its name is unstable
Capacitor counting leans on designator prefixes, a convention; the finding says so rather than reporting a confident zero

tools.name: shunt-plan
preconditions: Turns an UNKNOWN per-rail current into a bench measurement; it does not estimate the current
Sized from the regulator's RATED output, never the expected draw - sizing from the unknown would be circular
No fixed shunt value: the droop budget and the meter floor define a window, and an empty window is the answer
Plans only; it never edits a schematic, because generated schematics erase edits made behind the generator
--rail NAME=REF:PIN is VERIFIED against the netlist; no netlist is NO_COVERAGE, a mismatch is FAIL
Without --max-uncertainty-pct the achievable accuracy is computed but NOT judged
A shunt reads everything downstream: --rail-intended-load flags on-board loads lumped into the reading
Non-Kelvin sensing carries pad and trace resistance in series; without that term no accuracy is claimed
downstream_of_bypass puts resistance in series with the load's charge reservoir; refused without a stated reason

tools.name: correlate
preconditions: The first check whose numbers could show a MODEL is wrong; everything upstream is self-consistent
No measurement is NO_COVERAGE: the model is unfalsified, not confirmed
De-embedding is DECLARED by the caller, never inferred; an undeclared fixture is flagged
No interpolation: only frequencies in BOTH sweeps are compared
Needs a declared band; fewer than 8 shared points refuses rather than averaging noise
A small residual means model and measurement AGREE, not that either is right
An er correction from a delay error is a POINTER; nothing applies it automatically

tools.name: priors
preconditions: model_class=observed_frequency: counts what happened, NOT a trained model
Ranked by the Wilson 95% lower bound so 1/1 cannot outrank 40/40
Below --min-attempts a fix is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and is not ranked; an empty memory recommends nothing
needs_human is excluded from the denominator: an undecided attempt is not a lost one
Calibration is leave-one-out and is uninformative with fewer than 2 populated bins
Evidence is THIS project's history; it says nothing about a different stackup or fab
Reads the error memory; writes only its own --json

tools.name: benchmark
preconditions: scope=tool_invocations: measures TOOLS, not the agent's tool choice; not an end-to-end success rate
--repetitions must be >= 2; one run cannot detect nondeterminism
Pass rate is over COVERED runs; an absent dependency is NO_COVERAGE, not a failure
Determinism is TRI-STATE: null means the tool printed no JSON to compare, not that it drifted
A problem set is a sample: it says what these invocations do, not what every invocation would do
Runs the tools it benchmarks as subprocesses; writes only its own --json

tools.name: sparam
preconditions: Requires scikit-rf; its absence is NO_COVERAGE, never a pass
se2gmm's pairing was MEASURED by a three-layout probe plus closed-form skew agreement: ports 2k-1 and 2k form pair k
to_mixed_mode takes the pairing EXPLICITLY; a conductor-numbered s4p fed unpermuted reports a dead channel for a perfect one
Touchstone extension is derived from the port count; skrf picks its format from the file name
cascade() takes 2-ports unless allow_multiport is set; it refuses mismatched frequency axes rather than let skrf interpolate
Carries no channel mask of its own: IL/RL/mode-conversion limits are caller inputs
--line synthesises a uniform TEM trace, not a link: no vias, connectors, launches or bends
--line is LOSSLESS unless --tan-delta is given; the report states which

tools.name: parasitics
preconditions: Reads routed geometry out of the .kicad_pcb TEXT via common/sexpr.py - no pcbnew, no second process; the JSON/IPC bridge was measured to be unnecessary
--stackup is REQUIRED and every layer must carry a source: an er and a height multiply every number downstream
A routed layer absent from the stackup is SKIPPED and reported, never given default values
An unrouted board is refused: no parasitics is not the same as small parasitics
DC resistance only - no skin effect, so R is optimistic at speed
No coupling BETWEEN segments: each is solved alone over its plane, so crosstalk is absent by construction
Vias are COUNTED and NOT MODELLED; via inductance is missing from every number
Lumped single pi section per net; the report carries the frequency above which that shape is wrong
model_class SCREEN, signoff false: narrows where a layout hurts, never certifies that it does not

tools.name: eye
preconditions: signoff=false: PEAK DISTORTION bound, not a BER contour - a real eye at 1e-12 is WIDER, so a FAIL here is not proof the link is unusable
No transmitter/receiver model: no FFE/CTLE/DFE, no jitter, no crosstalk, no package
Opening is a FRACTION of full differential swing; volts only with --swing-v, never a guessed driver level
--ui-ps is required: an eye is defined per bit
Refuses a UI the frequency axis cannot resolve (<4 samples/UI would be a sampling artefact, not a channel property)
Extrapolates to DC explicitly; skrf only WARNS and returns a wrong step response
Port order is declared, not sniffed - Touchstone does not record it

tools.name: stackup-plan
preconditions: Screening only: model_class=exploratory_closed_form, signoff=false
Design-intent JSON is a required positional argument
Layer roles are rules of thumb; routing feasibility is not proven
UNRESOLVED (no valid layer count) exits 1 and is never a pass
Fab limits come from fixtures/references/fab_profiles.json and are representative until re-verified against the vendor's page
Writes no board or schematic file

tools.name: sync-tool-registry
preconditions: Writes only config/tool_registry.json

tools.name: gptpro-export
preconditions: Writes only inside OUTPUT_DIR; never mutates PROJECT_ROOT
Publishes a bundle set only when the coverage arithmetic closes
GREEN asserts snapshot scope and hashes only - never anything about the PCB design

tools.name: gptpro-export-engine
preconditions: Driven by gptpro-export; the plan file is not a public interface
Hashes both tool files into every manifest and receipt

tools.name: dfm-emc-check
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
scanned=0 reports NO_COVERAGE, never a silent PASS
Reads the board file; never writes it

tools.name: mask-dam
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
Straight PCB_TRACK only; arcs and zone fill are out of scope
Reads the board file; never writes it

tools.name: stitch-density
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
er_eff is a user input, not derived from the stackup
Reads the board file; never writes it

tools.name: via-stub
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
Screening only; sign-off is 3D EM
Reads the board file; never writes it

tools.name: sch-wire
preconditions: Library only; no CLI entrypoint
KiCad must be CLOSED before any write
Connectivity proof is the exported netlist, never the drawn wire

tools.name: sch-route
preconditions: Library only; no CLI entrypoint

tools.name: sch-wirefirst
preconditions: Library only; no CLI entrypoint
Etiket ancak LABEL_REASONS'taki bir gerekceyle konulabilir; component-to-component baglanti icin gecerli gerekce YOKTUR
Tek sayfali tasarimda 'sheet-to-sheet' gerekcesi reddedilir
Cizilen tel baglanti KANITI DEGILDIR; kanit netlist + wire-audit

Netlist verilmezse B ve G kontrolleri calismaz; kapi ACIK degil YOK
name_stitched_ok VARSAYILAN OLARAK BOS: 'GND zaten adla birlesir' istisnasi cagiran tarafindan YAZILI verilmelidir

tools.name: rewire
preconditions: KiCad must be CLOSED before any write
Proves the netlist after writing and rolls back from .bak on mismatch
Never expose over MCP: it mutates schematics

tools.name: wireify
preconditions: KiCad must be CLOSED before any write
Netlist must be unchanged; rolls back from .bak otherwise
Never expose over MCP: it mutates schematics

tools.name: ipc-trace-width
preconditions: IPC-2152 screening; not a substitute for the real current-capacity curves
Copper constant is derived (OZ_TO_MM*MM_TO_MIL), not the archive's 1.378 mil

tools.name: ipc-clearance
preconditions: IPC-2221 table interpolation; >50 V needs per-design verification against the standard

tools.name: ipc-fab-class
preconditions: IPC-6012 Class 1/2/3 limits; fab profile overrides these defaults

tools.name: ipc-dfa
preconditions: IPC-A-610 assembly clearances; assembler DFA rules override

tools.name: ipc-via-current
preconditions: No fixed A-per-via coefficient; plating thickness must come from the fab profile

tools.name: dru-emit
preconditions: Emits .kicad_dru only; the LAST matching rule wins, so general rules come first
Only track_width/clearance/annular_width are verified; others carry verified_constraint=false
Prove the rule ran (fault-injection) before claiming it was injected

tools.name: emc-rules
preconditions: Screening only: model_class=exploratory_closed_form, signoff=false
f_knee_edge (0.35/tr) and f_nyquist (rate/2) are different quantities; do not mix

tools.name: collision-radar
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
Reads the board file; never writes it
Placement truth is this JSON, never a rendered image
Board outline is a bounding box; rounded outlines can give a false negative

tools.name: gerber-dfm
preconditions: Reads exported RS-274X gerbers: evidence independent of symbolic DRC
Unknown apertures are excluded from the gap maths and listed in params.parse_warnings

tools.name: mcad-collision
preconditions: Requires kicad-cli STEP export
Bodies are caller-supplied; STEP B-rep is NOT parsed
Components without body data are reported as untested, never as clean

tools.name: thermal-bridge
preconditions: KiCad must be CLOSED before any write
Verifies its own output and rolls back from .bak
Never expose over MCP: it mutates the board

tools.name: decoupling-coverage
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
DISCOVERS IC power pins from the board - complements measure-board, which only checks the REF.PAD:REF.PAD pairs the caller names
Heuristic: IC detection by footprint package name, power pins by net-name token - an unrecognised footprint is UNSCANNED, never silently clean; always read 'scanned'
Straight-line pad-centre distance, not the real current loop; necessary but not sufficient
'capacitor_too_far' and 'no_capacitor' are separate violations: different fixes

tools.name: measure-board
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
Reads the board file; never writes it
Vendored L0 evidence tool: lengths are arc length (GetLength), not chord

tools.name: skew-timing
preconditions: Derived metric only: converts measure_board's pair_skew_mm to ps; takes no measurement of its own and needs no pcbnew
REQUIRES a propagation input - --solve (2-D field solver) or --er-eff WITH --er-eff-source. Never defaults it; escape_geom's typical FR4 velocity is not reachable from here
A pair with no copper on either net is NO_COVERAGE, never the 0.0 mm skew measure_board reports for it
No default skew budget: without --budget-ps AND --budget-source the metric is emitted INCONCLUSIVE (recorded, unjudged), which is not a pass
board_sha256 is copied from the parent report's design.sha256; a parent without one is refused

tools.name: pair-coupling
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
Reads the board file; never writes it
Screening only: model_class=exploratory_closed_form, signoff=false
COUPLED 0/0 is NO_COVERAGE, never a pass

tools.name: drc-gate
preconditions: Always passes --exit-code-violations and --severity-all; without them DRC exits 0 on a dirty board
Vendored from tools/krt/drc.sh, which hid tool failure and hardcoded one board's project file
Every report carries provenance.engine_version, MEASURED with `kicad-cli version` at run time, plus the path-free argv_signature
--compare REFUSES (exit 2) two reports whose kicad-cli version or invocation flags differ or are unknown; a 191-vs-222 delta across 10.0.5 and 10.0.4 is not a measurement

tools.name: independent-verify
preconditions: Second verifier, independent of DRC
A malformed contract is exit 2, never an empty NO_COVERAGE pass

tools.name: place-force-directed
preconditions: Proposes coordinates only; it does not write the board

tools.name: route-grid-astar
preconditions: Last-resort router; the ONLY search budget is --max-nodes (there is no time or bbox limit)
A tripped budget is reported as found=false + reason, and NO_COVERAGE/FAIL both exit 1
cell_mm must be smaller than half of (trace width + clearance) or a corridor can be missed
Produces polylines only; it does NOT write the board
No diff-pair and no net-class awareness: pairs must be handled by the caller

tools.name: route-topological
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
pcbnew import is lazy and confined to the write path; the CLI never calls write_tracks()
Single-step shove only; not KiCad's PNS router
An unsupplied lower-layer obstacle list is NOT read as an empty layer: no via is proposed
An empty request set exits 1 (route_found=NO_COVERAGE), not 0
No diff-pair and no net-class awareness; high_speed only forbids vias

tools.name: production-contracts
preconditions: Fail-closed on an unrecognised contract schema

tools.name: production-freerouting
preconditions: Requires java + freerouting.jar; NOT exercised in this environment
Diff pairs are NOT carried into DSN: route and LOCK them before calling
Exits 1 on NO_COVERAGE: 'the router did not run' must not read as 'routed'
WRITES the board on a successful SES import (board.Save); run it on a scratch copy only
A True SES import with an unchanged track count is NOT a routed board
Runs no DRC afterwards: a routing result is not a verdict
A missing jar fails closed by default; --allow-jar-download opts into fetching it from GitHub releases (untested against the live API, no checksum pinned)

tools.name: production-outputs
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
Requires KiBot; NOT exercised in this environment
Re-runs DRC/ERC before emitting fab outputs; fail-closed

tools.name: promote
preconditions: Emits a gate-receipt/v1 that gate_receipt.py must validate GREEN
--apply requires --atomic; canonical files are replaced with os.replace
Zero contract verifiers is NO_COVERAGE -> RED, never a pass

tools.name: pipeline-adapters
preconditions: Library only: each function forwards to an already-registered tool with no report of its own
No hardcoded sequencing - no function calls another (enforced by test_pipeline_adapters.py's AST check)
--self-test is the only CLI surface; import it as a library for real use

tools.name: error-memory
preconditions: Writes under var/memory/ only; any path inside a .obsidian tree is refused
Returns known-failed fixes as 'do not retry', never as advice

tools.name: recovery
preconditions: Writes under var/memory/ only
EXHAUSTED (all rungs failed) is distinct from NO_LADDER (config fault)

tools.name: ngspice-bridge
preconditions: Requires the ngspice binary (verified against ngspice-46)
Behavioural models must declare what they do NOT model (--model-note)
Simulation is not measurement: signoff stays with the bench

tools.name: cross-section
preconditions: Optional tier: svglib/reportlab/Pillow/poppler, imported lazily
visual_guidance_only=true, measurement_admissible=false: never gate on this

tools.name: mechanical-dxf
preconditions: Requires ezdxf; reads a REAL DXF outline, never a stubbed one
Produces keepout_zones.json against the mekanik-dxf skill's own schema

tools.name: current-density
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
Resistive-mesh screening model, not a field solver; see its own accuracy-boundary note

tools.name: openems-bridge
preconditions: Requires pcbnew for geometry extraction; skrf is optional for Touchstone evaluation
No FDTD engine here: prepares/evaluates simulation inputs and outputs only

tools.name: route-diff-pair
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
Locks an ALREADY-close pair with a direct track; does not search a route from scratch
Writes the board: run on a scratch copy only

tools.name: route-safe-write
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
Rolls back to the pre-write board on a DRC/unconnected-count regression

tools.name: routing-table
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
Every field is extracted from the board; nothing is guessed or hand-filled
XLSX output needs openpyxl; falls back to CSV-only when it is absent

tools.name: pmic-allocation
preconditions: Project-specific rail-to-output greedy match; not a BOM/datasheet-level capability check

tools.name: capability-inventory
preconditions: Static AST analysis; security/dependency columns are heuristic, not a guarantee

tools.name: verify-placement
preconditions: Does NOT require pcbnew - reads the board as text. Deliberate: a guard that cannot run in the interpreter the package uses is a guard that never runs
Frame transform is MEASURED from the Edge.Cuts bounding box; with no board outline the tool returns 2 and does not pass
Courtyard boxes default to 1.0 x 0.6 mm unless --bodies is given; zone-overlap detection is only as good as those boxes

tools.name: route-audit
preconditions: Does NOT require pcbnew - reads the board as text, for the same reason as verify-placement
Contains NO clearance numbers of its own. The edge ring comes from board_outline.json, else .kicad_pro; with neither the result is NO_COVERAGE, and NO_COVERAGE exits 1 because it is not a PASS

Reports AYRISMA when board_outline.json and .kicad_pro declare different edge rings, and audits against the DECLARATION - the two numbers produce two different violation counts and both are correct for their own rule

Cross-checked against KiCad DRC by UUID on cam-w-og05b10 (2026-08-10): hole_clearance 49/49, hole_to_hole 3/3, copper_edge_clearance 21/21 identical; the 25 via findings absent from KiCad `clearance` are all in `shorting_items`
Track-to-track and pad-to-pad copper clearance are OUT OF SCOPE and declared as such in the run header; do not read a GREEN here as a clean DRC

tools.name: footprint-factory
preconditions: Contains NO land-pattern numbers of its own. Every dimension comes from the declaration JSON, where each one carries a `src`. Writing a number into this file would cut it from its source - the exact defect the tool exists to fix

Generates from the MANUFACTURER's recommended land pattern, not from a package outline standard. The two are different documents and they disagree: measured 2026-08-10, all three of cam-w's generic library footprints deviated from their vendor drawing
Courtyard is DERIVED from the real pad extent and the body, never passed in. A hand-passed courtyard can be smaller than the pads and nothing would object

Two vendors can specify different land patterns for the SAME package (Microchip SOT-23 c-c 2.80 vs TI DBV 2.60). Entries are therefore per-PART, not per-package; a shared package entry would silently print one of them wrong
--check compares generated against on-disk and reports EKSIK / AYRISMA / BEYANSIZ. It does NOT verify the numbers against the datasheet - that is a human reading and lives in the `src` fields

tools.name: verify-manifest
preconditions: Validates the SSOT (design_manifest.json) and, when given them, checks that derived files and neighbouring declarations have not DRIFTED from it - a source whose derivative disagrees is not a single source
Reuses verify_zones' validation engine; a second engine would drift from the first
Exit 2 (input unreadable) is RED at the caller, never a skip

tools.name: sync-skills
preconditions: Materializes pcb-agent/skills into .claude/skills so the harness can load them; .claude/skills is DERIVED and hand edits are overwritten on the next sync
--check is the gate mode: missing, stale, orphaned or frontmatter-less skills are RED, never silently skipped

tools.name: verify-zones
preconditions: Validates the DECLARATION (board_outline.json zones), not the board; a zone that is well-formed here can still be violated in copper - that is verify-placement's job
Reads one contract with two engines (jsonschema if installed, else a bundled mini interpreter of the SAME .json). Rules are never transcribed into Python, so schema and validator cannot drift apart
Three rules JSON Schema cannot express live in the validator: id uniqueness, escape_layer must appear in exclude_layers, and allowed_refs_why keys must be a subset of allowed_refs
An empty or absent zones array is a WARNING, not an error - only cam-w declares zones today, so this contract binds one board

tools.name: reference-plane
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG); pin to 10.0.x
Checks segment endpoints and midpoint only; a very short mid-segment void can be missed

tools.name: testpoint-plan
preconditions: Validated against skills/dft-testpoints/references/testpoint_plan.schema.json

tools.name: jlcpcb-dfm
preconditions: CONFIRM: request/response shape is a documented GUESS, not verified against a real JLCPCB account - see the module's own STATUS note before trusting a result
Endpoint and API key come ONLY from JLCPCB_DFM_ENDPOINT/JLCPCB_API_KEY env vars, never hardcoded
--allow-network is required even when both env vars are set (uploads the design to a third party)
Missing config, network error, or an unrecognised response are all NO_COVERAGE, never a fabricated PASS

tools.name: jlc-library
preconditions: Requires the JLC2KiCadLib PyPI package; -dir/-symbol_lib/--skip_existing flags verified against its published --help output
Cache is a success MARKER keyed by (lcsc_code, symbol_lib, output_dir), not a file copy - a different destination is always a cache miss
A missing tool or a non-zero exit raises, never returns a fabricated success

tools.name: bom-lifecycle
preconditions: Makes NO network call - the skill's own schema assigns the query to the main agent (provider.queried_from), so supply data is an INPUT (--supply), never fetched here
A line with no supply data is CONFIRM, never a silent Active; unmeasured risk_score is null, not 0
NRND/EOL/Obsolete is RED with no prototype exception (MASTER_RULEBOOK Bölüm 0)
risk_score is clamped to the schema's maximum of 1.0; the raw stacked sum is preserved in the reasons rather than discarded
Output validated against skills/bom-lifecycle/references/lifecycle_report.schema.json by the test suite, in the full / no-supply / stale states

tools.name: cad-assets
preconditions: Makes NO network call - download_allowed() only JUDGES a URL (https + a narrow host allowlist); the agent performs the transfer, so this stays deterministic and testable
Pin numbers are read from the S-expression NESTING via common.sexpr, not by matching a (number "..") token anywhere in the file
Multi-unit / De Morgan duplicates are collapsed; the exposed pad is NEVER filtered out (MASTER_RULEBOOK Faz 1 requires it counted and GND-tied)
register_assets raises PermissionError unless the pin-count gate passed - a gate a caller can step around is not a gate
lib-table registration is idempotent: a duplicate nickname makes KiCad refuse to open the project
Writes into the project library dir and lib-tables; NOT MCP-exposed

tools.name: ai-feedback-loop
preconditions: Requires pcbnew (KiCad 10 SWIG) for apply_trace_geometry; the solver step itself does not
Delegates geometry correction to common.stackup.solve_impedance_geometry - no closed-form duplicated here
Raises RuntimeError/ConvergenceError on failure - never returns a fabricated PASS
Applies track width only; KiCad has no direct net-to-net gap API, so gap correction is NOT applied

tools.name: assert-matrix
preconditions: MEASURES NOTHING - an assertion binds a claim to a LOCATION in a report another tool produced; re-deriving the quantity here would give the repo two answers to one question
The matrix level decides what a PASS may establish: A/B must carry an executable predicate (else UNBACKED_CLAIM), C passes only as record_only, D without a measurement record is NO_COVERAGE
Numeric operators REQUIRE an explicit tolerance - it may be 0, but a boundary policy is chosen rather than inherited from float arithmetic
'units' without 'units_selector' does not load (UNITS_UNBOUND); an unlabelled number compared against a labelled threshold is undetectable afterwards
No wildcard selectors: coverage whose size depends on the report passes vacuously on the empty set
A selector that finds nothing is PATH_ABSENT -> NO_COVERAGE, never PASS and never FAIL
--prove injects each declared falsifier and requires FAIL; still passing is VACUOUS_ASSERTION, dropping to NO_COVERAGE is FALSIFIER_NO_COVERAGE
Evidence without a declared hash binding can produce a real result but never GREEN (SCREEN_ONLY) - the call section 5 of the matrix already made
A declared artifact that is not on disk is ARTIFACT_MISSING -> FAIL, never a quiet fallback to unbound: a typo must not be the cheapest way to silence a staleness check
An UNASSERTED_RULE is NO_COVERAGE (silence), an ORPHAN_ASSERTION is FAIL (enforcement aimed at a rule that no longer exists passes forever and reads as coverage)
Rule matching is exact on normalised text, never fuzzy - a reworded row must orphan its assertion rather than silently re-point it at a neighbour
Reads skills/dogrulama-matrisi/SKILL.md; never writes it

tools.name: model-registry
preconditions: Never judges whether a model is ACCURATE - that is sim/correlate.py's question and it needs a measurement. This answers WHICH model, and may it be used HERE
valid_range is REQUIRED with a unit on every axis; a query outside it is OUT_OF_ENVELOPE -> NO_COVERAGE, never a clamped or extrapolated number
Out-of-envelope is NOT a design failure - the board is not wrong, the model does not reach; conflating the two sends somebody hunting for a defect that is not there
An axis the query asks about but the model never declared is NO_COVERAGE, not an implicit pass
authority has NO DEFAULT: only vendor_published may close a sign-off gate; vendor_derived and synthetic produce real results and are counted separately
provenance requires vendor + document + revision + accessed - a vendor document without a revision and a date names a FAMILY of documents
A registered file whose bytes moved is STALE_MODEL -> FAIL: a model swapped under an id keeps the authority of the one it replaced
No registered sha256 is DIGEST_UNVERIFIED -> NO_COVERAGE, never a silent pass
A superseded model is REFUSED, not annotated - it still produces numbers, which is why a note is not enough
The declared range is cross-checked against the file itself where readable; a declaration exceeding its own data is ENVELOPE_OVERCLAIMS -> FAIL
Touchstone reading is delegated to common.tline.read_touchstone - a second reader here would be the #54 failure repeated on purpose
An unverifiable declaration is ENVELOPE_UNCHECKED -> NO_COVERAGE, never PASS
Makes NO network call and ships no models; it records provenance and gates use

tools.name: topology-advise
preconditions: Every other solver optimises WITHIN a fixed topology; this proposes CHANGING it - adding an element, never tuning one
Emits HYPOTHESES, not fixes: no component value is chosen, no schematic is edited, and nothing here claims the change works
States a DIRECTION, never a magnitude. A catalogue entry whose text contains a unit does not load (MAGNITUDE_CLAIMED) - this module runs no solver
Triggered only by FAIL/NO_COVERAGE findings other tools already produced; a PASS is not a shortfall and proposing against one is recommending work for its own sake
Measures nothing itself - a second measurement here would give the repo two answers to one question (#51 / #54)
Every entry must name a verifying tool (else UNVERIFIABLE_PROPOSAL) and a refuting observation (else UNFALSIFIABLE_PROPOSAL)
Every entry must state its COST; one listing only benefits is a sales pitch
Every entry must carry at least one condition that rules it out - a transformation fitting every shortfall fits none (UNCONDITIONAL_TRANSFORM)
Exclusion facts are SUPPLIED via --context, never inferred: whether a reference plane is split is what reference_plane.py measures
An EXCLUDED proposal is an answer, not a violation - often the most informative line
Parameter changes an existing solver owns are reported as ALREADY_OWNED rather than skipped; silence reads as 'no tool covers this' and starts a second implementation
Never returns RED on a design - it cannot find a defect; an unaddressable shortfall is NO_COVERAGE

tools.name: boot-observability
preconditions: Answers the question a bring-up bench asks first: the board does not boot, WHICH rail failed - by crossing rail_budget's enable graph against testpoint_plan's scope
Counts DISTINGUISHABLE FAILURE CLASSES, not rails-with-testpoints: a plan can cover every rail by count and still leave two failures producing one symptom
Ambiguity lives INSIDE an enable tier; rails in different tiers are already separated in time because the later tier never starts
Power-good is NEVER a rail measurement - a regulator asserts PG into a rail held down by a downstream short; PG-only coverage is NO_COVERAGE, not PASS
One real measurement resolves a two-rail tier: the other becomes distinguishable by elimination. Distinguishable is still not the same as observed, and the run says so
An observation kind has NO DEFAULT; an uncategorised test point is ignored rather than assumed to prove a rail
A reset is a separate failure kind: released before its rails, it gives a powered dead board that looks nothing like a missing rail
A reset waiting on an undeclared rail is refused - the sequence it claims to respect cannot be checked against anything
An enable cycle is refused, never reported against a fabricated order
Does NOT check physical probe access - there is no placement at this phase, and testpoint_plan.py already draws that line (phase: early_schematic, physical: null)

tools.name: connector-current
preconditions: A connector rating is CAPACITY, never DEMAND: capacity is read from connector_spec.json and demand from rail_tree.json, and the two must be separate documents or the cross-check is a document checked against itself

connector_spec's own current.rail_cross_check block is NEVER read as demand - whoever wrote the capacity wrote it. Where it declares a worst case it is compared against the rail tree and a disagreement is a FAIL

N x I_rated does not load (capacity.policy 'n_times_rated' is refused): the centre contact runs hottest, sheds current to the outer ones, and the derating curve depends on ambient AND on how many adjacent contacts carry
Capacity for more than one contact must be READ for that grouping and carry its source; a stated group rating without a source is GROUP_RATING_UNSOURCED -> NO_COVERAGE
The room-temperature rating is NEVER substituted for a missing derating curve - it is the optimistic number, not a conservative stand-in (konnektor SKILL 1 and 3b)
derating_basis 'adjacent_contact_screen' is LOCAL_POLICY, not a datasheet curve: it can rule a connector out and never signs one off
A derating with no stated ambient is NO_COVERAGE - a curve is a function of temperature and 'derated' alone does not say derated to what
rail-tree/v1 pins seven fields and forbids others, so it cannot hold provenance for i_max_a; the map carries it and an unsourced demand is NO_COVERAGE
The rail -> contact-group mapping is an INPUT (--map). Which rail crosses which contact is a project fact belonging to system-planning/, not to this tool
A rail neither mapped nor excluded with a reason is MAPPING_INCOMPLETE -> NO_COVERAGE, never a partial pass over the rails that happened to be listed
No margin is defaulted: without --min-margin-a only the SIGN of capacity - demand is judged
Compares two DOCUMENTS and measures nothing; contact current sharing stays a C->D electro-thermal measurement and signoff is pinned false

tools.name: interconnect-mating
preconditions: The `eligible` universe is derived from interface_contract.json's REQUIRED link set, never from the declared chain list: with two links declared and a third forgotten, a declaration-derived denominator reports eligible=2/scanned=2/violations=0 -> GREEN and the missing link never enters the universe (docs/BULGU-bos-kontrol-temiz-gorunur.md:79-85)

The chain file may NOT state its own denominator: an eligible/coverage/coverage_hint/edge_count/declared_eligible key is REFUSED (exit 2), not ignored - ignoring it would leave a reader believing the number was honoured
Contract and chain must be SEPARATE documents; running with one is refused, because denominator and numerator from one file is a document checked against itself

A contract-required interface with no chain, or a chain with no mating edge, keeps a one-edge contract minimum in the denominator and violates MISSING_TRANSITION - deleting the declaration does not shrink the universe

`medium` is NOT nullable in meaning: a null medium is NO_MATED_PART/RED with the link NAMED, and the edge stays SCANNED. A cable assembly is a third unit and a separate BOM line (Digi-Key codes housings 390 != assemblies 399 != flat flex cables)

Both edge classes count: `mating` (face <-> neighbour face = physical fit) and `internal` (a node's two faces, a cable's two ends = netlist continuity / straight vs reversed). CAM-W measured why: J101 pin 17 = XVCLK, J201 pin 17 = FSYNC

R4 (position count) is authority=screen_only and does NOT open a signature - 20=20 passes while pin 1 lands on pin 20. On RPi 5 the CSI and DSI ports are physically IDENTICAL (22-pin, 0.5 mm, 11.5 mm) and the cables are separate SKUs. The signature is carried by R10 (pin_to_pin mandatory) + R11 (net identity)
A screen_only FAIL still closes the gate (a 30-contact cable does not fit a 22-contact socket); a record_only FAIL (R6/R8/R16/R19/R20) adds a CONFIRM cap and does not

R12 (POWER_ON_SIGNAL_PIN) is the killer rule: a wrong pin map in MIPI is not 'does not work', it is 3V3 riding a D-PHY lane = permanent damage. R6 makes a silent open, R12 a silent kill; they are not the same priority

NO ALIAS TABLE: net names are compared EXACTLY. MIPI_D0_P != CSI_D0_P is a VIOLATION and the fix is correcting the contract or the board, never normalising (ecad-varlik-kalifikasyonu:130-133). Same net set in the wrong order is PIN_ORDER_MISMATCH

A vendor contact-face letter is NEVER a key: Molex A/D, Wurth 1/2, market A/B - and Molex has no 'B'. Only the normalised SAME_SIDE/OPPOSITE_SIDE enum feeds a decision; the letter lives in provenance as raw data
An unmeasured quantity is None, never 0, and a comparison over a null is NO_COVERAGE, never PASS: null == null is not equality

`scanned` is the population actually examined, NOT eligible - excluded: deriving it makes the arithmetic hold by construction, so excluding a phantom edge would silently shrink the numerator. A phantom exclusion is INVALID_COVERAGE (exit 2)

An exclusion without a reason stays SCANNED, lands in unjustified_exclusions and forces RED (sistem-arayuz-sozlesmesi:150-158). Edge ids contain ':' so the parser matches the longest known id, not the first colon

Provenance is a CAP axis, not a finding: unsourced is neither a measured mismatch (RED) nor 'nobody looked' (NO_COVERAGE) - it caps at CONFIRM. basis derived/vendor_page -> SCREEN_ONLY, local_policy -> LOCAL_POLICY; none reaches GREEN

gate.verdict uses the CLOSED 15-value vocabulary; the domain answer (CHAIN_COMPLETE / CHAIN_BROKEN / MEDIUM_UNSPECIFIED / PINMAP_UNVERIFIED / DECLARED_NONMATCHING) lives in `domain_state` and never leaks into it. Where both appear, gate.verdict binds

Selects no part (bom-lifecycle), connects no net and opens no schematic (sematik-erc), measures no volume overlap (mekanik-dxf), computes no current/derating/cycle budget (konnektor), judges no single part's symbol/footprint identity (ecad-varlik-kalifikasyonu - this is its SIBLING, not its superior)

writes_board=false, signoff=false, assurance_loop=[L1, L2] with NO L3: a skill that publishes no PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT cannot close an L3 rule (coverage-gate.md:75-77). Physical fit is handed to l3-bringup-karakterizasyon via an l3_rule_universe row where THIS gate owns the limit; naming the L3 skill as owner_skill is SELF_AUTHORED_LIMIT

Reads the canonical interface-contract/v1 AND the board-local pcb-agent/interface_contract shape, and RECORDS which one it read: refusing one would close the gate to the repo's own data, staying silent would hide that two shapes exist

tools.name: hand-solder-gate
preconditions: Scope is hand-solder / perfboard / prototype schematics ONLY; the tool refuses boards whose folder name does not look hand-solder unless --force is given. It is explicitly NOT applicable to the hierarchical, net-label schematics drawn for fab

L1 is not a gate on its own and the file says so: two separate 'FSYNC' labels, each sitting on its own 2.54 mm stub at opposite ends of the sheet, both pass L1 while no wire joins them. The verdict lives in L2 - every pin of a net inside ONE wire-connected component
Connectivity follows KiCad's own rules: a wire end touching another wire's body (T) connects, two wires crossing (X) without a junction do NOT
Power nets (GND, VCC, ...) are exempt by default and may be joined by power symbols plus short stubs; --strict removes that exemption and demands wire for rails too

Exit codes DEVIATE from the repo's canonical 0/1/2: this tool returns 0 GREEN, 2 RED, 3 input missing/unreadable. A caller that reads 2 as 'tool could not answer' will misread a real violation as an environment failure

tools.name: i2c-pullup
preconditions: Ships NO I2C constant: Standard-mode, Fast-mode and Fast-mode Plus differ only in what the caller declares, and a baked-in 300 ns would assert a spec revision this file never read
VDD, VOL, IOL, C_bus and tr each arrive as {value, source:{document, revision}} or they do not arrive; a bare number is a GAP, and a gap is NO_COVERAGE, never a PASS
The ~0.85 in the matrix note is DERIVED from the declared measurement band (ln((1-f_lo)/(1-f_hi))), so it is attributable to the clause the caller cited
The pull-up network is resolved from the NETLIST by topology - a two-pin part bridging the segment and the declared rail - never by designator prefix
Reports the PARALLEL equivalent: two boards each carrying a correct 4.7k present 2.35k, and no single-resistor review catches it
A two-pin bridging part whose value will not read (DNP, a diode) is NO_COVERAGE - dropping it would bias the equivalent high, which is the direction that passes
A part with more than two pins touching both nets is recorded, not modelled: a slave IC is indistinguishable from a FET level shifter here
An unresolvable segment or rail net is NO_COVERAGE, never 'no pull-ups found'
One C_bus and one VOL/IOL per segment, both declared: the tool does not derive capacitance from routing and does not choose the weakest driver for you
DC and RC only: no bus timing, no hold time, no arbitration, no clock stretching

tools.name: cad-asset-qualification
preconditions: Makes NO network call and does NOT extract datasheets - no PDF parser, no OCR, no table scraper; the authoritative pin/package record is a declared, human/vendor-authored input
Semantic layer ON TOP of cad-assets, not a replacement: check_pin_count, lifecycle_gate and register_assets are imported and run underneath
Pin/pad/package data is read from the S-expression NESTING via common.sexpr
Pin names are compared EXACTLY (whitespace-stripped only) - no case folding, no ~{} overbar rewriting, no alias table: a normaliser is where a mismatch goes to die quietly
A dimension or tolerance the source does not state is an EXCLUDED attribute with a reason, never a default; an excluded package attribute caps the run at CONFIRM
Provenance-incomplete source (document_id/revision/locator/accessed/snapshot_sha256) can reach at most CONFIRM, never GREEN
Only a manufacturer land pattern permits GREEN; ipc_derived/local_library with a recorded derivation is LOCAL_POLICY, without one SCREEN_ONLY - neither is a sign-off
Selects no part (bom-lifecycle owns MPN/lifecycle), connects no net (sematik-erc), judges no manufacturability (dfm); lifecycle is READ ONLY
Exit 0 only on GREEN - CONFIRM/STALE/LOCAL_POLICY/SCREEN_ONLY/NO_COVERAGE all exit 1, unlike bom-lifecycle, because this is a release gate
--register writes into the project library dir and lib-tables and is refused unless the verdict is GREEN; NOT MCP-exposed

tools.name: first-article
preconditions: Consumes a STRUCTURED assembler/AOI/X-ray/MSL record plus a hash-bound evidence locator; it never opens the locator and never interprets an image
Runs after Faz 4c: the released Gerber/BOM/CPL package must exist and be hash-identified before the built unit can be compared with it
Same revision + different package bytes is RED (silent substitution); a different revision is STALE (good evidence about another board) - two different failures
GREEN is an as-built conformance statement, not a reliability qualification
Emits assembly_acceptance_receipt.json as a gate-receipt/v1 FRAGMENT; tools/scripts/gate_receipt.py is what validates and closes the gate
A hidden-joint package with no X-ray record, or a required inspection universe with zero records, is NO_COVERAGE/CONFIRM and never GREEN
--declare-out-of-scope records an explicit exclusion with a reason; it forces NO_COVERAGE and cannot produce GREEN

tools.name: physical-measurement
preconditions: The repo's FIRST producer of evidence_origin=PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT; ten skills listed L3 and all eighteen published TOOL_REPORT
Talks to NO instrument and takes NO measurement: it decides whether a record somebody else took is admissible evidence for a named rule on a named unit
Invents no threshold. A limit arrives as an input with owner_skill + document_id + locator, or the row is NO_COVERAGE - never GREEN, never a default
A limit whose authority names this skill is refused (SELF_AUTHORED_LIMIT): a gate that writes its own threshold measures itself
The accepted first article is a PRECONDITION; an unaccepted unit (or gate.serial_release false) is RED, not a note
A record whose board_revision/board_hash/serial/lot do not all match the accepted unit is STALE - no evidence about this board, not weaker evidence
Uncalibrated is not measured: no calibration id/date is NO_COVERAGE. An unwritten setup cannot be repeated, so it is not evidence either
TDR/VNA evidence needs reference_plane, measurement_zone, port_map, reference_impedance, fixture and deembed_method or it is INVALID_SPARAM (highspeed-routing SKILL.md 6)
The value is compared as an interval widened by uncertainty + guard_band; a margin inside that interval is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS
Pre-compliance is SCREEN_ONLY, is never compared with a formal limit and never closes a row; accredited compliance without the lab artifact is CONFIRM
Adds no test point and patches no board: RED opens an L2 edge to the rule's declared owner (writes_board false)

tools.name: crosstalk-mcp
preconditions: Transport only; all engineering verdicts come from crosstalk-thinning
Tool surface is analyze_crosstalk_and_thinning; unknown arguments are rejected
stdlib-only stdio JSON-RPC (MCP 2024-11-05); no mcp package required

tools.name: board-checks-mcp
preconditions: Transport only; all measurements come from the four board checkers
Requires pcbnew; runs in a separate process from pcb-crosstalk
board argument is confined to PCB_AGENT_BOARD_ROOT and must be .kicad_pcb
Exposes read-only checkers only; never rewire/wireify/context-pack --postflight

tools.name: kicad-cli
preconditions: Use --exit-code-violations for ERC/DRC gates
Use --severity-all for sign-off

tools.name: ngspice
preconditions: Use for power/analog analysis, never as MIPI CSI-2 SI evidence

tools.name: kicad-ipc
preconditions: KiCad IPC API enabled
pcbnew GUI open with target board
Never parallelize IPC calls
